    • readAnnotationDefaultValues

      protected Map<? extends Object, ?> readAnnotationDefaultValues(String annotationName, Object annotationType, boolean includeEmptyValues)
      The defaults an annotation type declares, by the same rule as the Java, Kotlin and Groovy builders: every member with a default is reported, whatever its shape, except that an empty string default is reported only when includeEmptyValues is set. The written metadata omits it to stay small, and AnnotationValue.stringValue answers empty for an absent member anyway; VisitorContext.getAnnotationDefaultValues asks for it, so that "no default" can be told apart from "the empty string".
      Overrides:
      readAnnotationDefaultValues in class io.micronaut.inject.annotation.AbstractAnnotationMetadataBuilder<Object, ScalaAnnotationData>
